subject.title: Feishu card action: pass through form_value, input_value and other fields

question: What Feishu card-action payload contract should OpenClaw expose for `form_value`, `input_value`, `option`, `options`, and `name` fields?
rationale: The implementation is owner-local, but the resulting JSON/text shape becomes agent-visible channel behavior and affects compatibility with existing command-style button actions.

options.title: Structured passthrough
options.body: Expose `value` plus present interactive fields as structured JSON only when extra fields exist, while preserving simple button command behavior.

options.title: Limit scope to form submissions first
options.body: Ship only `form_value` pass-through now and leave selector/input payload shape to a follow-up if maintainers want a smaller compatibility surface.

options.title: Defer richer callbacks
options.body: Keep Feishu card actions command-only for now and require custom plugin HTTP routes until maintainers define a broader interactive-card event API.

recommendation.title: Structured passthrough
recommendation.body: Expose `value` plus present interactive fields as structured JSON only when extra fields exist, while preserving simple button command behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu package metadata names this handle as the community maintainer for the affected channel plugin.
